listing.title: My First Robots Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Robot Pages – Robot Dog, Flying Robot, Chef Robot & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly robots!

Little hands color 30 pictures of happy robots, from a classic box robot, a round robot and a flying robot to a robot dog, a chef robot and two robot friends holding hands. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a happy face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Robots of every shape: Robot, Round Robot, Tall Robot, Robot on Wheels, Robot with Tracks, Flying Robot, Jet Pack Robot, Bouncy Robot, Wind-Up Robot and a Robot with a Balloon
  • Robot animals: Robot Dog, Robot Cat, Robot Bunny, Robot Bird, Robot Fish, Robot Dinosaur, Robot Owl and Robot Turtle
  • Robots with a job: Chef Robot, Painter Robot, Music Robot, Garden Robot, Cleaning Robot, Builder Robot and Delivery Robot
  • Robot things and friends: Robot Arm, Battery, Gear, Remote Control and Robot Friends
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
